verdict.rationale: Better Stack docs mention only two token tiers — a global API token valid across all teams and a team-scoped Uptime API token (betterstack-docs-15, betterstack-docs-51) — which provides coarse-grained scoping but no evidence of fine-grained, per-resource, or agent-specific least-privilege credential issuance. Missing for 10: granular permission/action scopes, read-only vs write distinctions, agent-specific credential creation flows, and any independent confirmation of least-privilege enforcement.
